summary: Pin is in dense garden bush; nearest van spot is the gardens car park west.
reasons: Pin itself has no track or vehicles
Gardens car park 83 m away, no homes
Cafe and staffed grounds, busy by day

best_section.where: Sealed gardens car park beside the cafe, west of the pin

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings nearby; surrounded by garden bush, but cafe and visitor car park are close.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin is in thick bush with no track. Sealed car park aisles off the access road have bays for a van.
drivers.traffic: Mt Coot-tha Road passes to the north with buses and cars; car park busy by day.
drivers.convention: Many cars parked there by day; overnight use inside the botanic gardens is unknown.

flags: Pin lands in bush; place judged is the car park about 83 m away
Slope at pin about 5% mean, 14.6% max in bush
Possible overnight closure or signs not visible from above
Pond and creek nearby, ground about 25 m elevation
sun_shade: Car park edge is mostly open with tree shade from the east side.
cannot_judge: Gardens opening hours and overnight rules
